title: An event router
description:
Send each webhook event to the right handler, with wildcards.

```
order.paid      -> on_order_paid, log_everything
order.refunded  -> on_any_order, log_everything
user.created    -> log_everything
```
hints: For `order.refunded`, try `"order.refunded"`, then `"order.*"` (the part before the dot plus `.*`), then always `"*"`.
requirements: An exact match runs before a wildcard; `order.*` runs only when there is no exact handler; `*` always runs.
Errors in one handler are logged and do not stop the others.
stretch: Test it with fake events and `unittest`, checking which handlers ran.
